# Forbes

> > Forbes is a global media company providing business news, financial analysis, and entrepreneurial insights, with digital advertising and brand recognition services.

Forbes offers both content and business services including a self-service advertising platform for digital marketing campaigns and an accolade store for companies to showcase Forbes awards and recognition.

## Key Topics

- Forbes Ad Manager
- Digital Advertising
- Self-Service Ads
- Campaign Management
- Audience Targeting
- B2B Marketing
- Forbes Awards
- Company Recognition
- Professional Services Awards
- Brand Partnerships

## Advertising & Marketing Platforms

- [Forbes Ad Manager](https://admanager.forbes.com/): Self-service advertising platform for brand partners and audience targeting

## Optional

- [Forbes Accolade Store](https://accoladesproducts.forbes.com/): Store for Forbes awards and recognition products for companies
